scope: Risk-focused test specifications awaiting final shared mapping/history contract
testFormat: Signature-neutral temporal actions and assertions; no map DTO,renderer state or production history API is defined here.

setup: Register1001p paste and capture admitted mapping context.
actions: Reset; register1001q paste recreating identical marker ID/display/length.
Deliver old map with one Up key.
assertions: Reject before mutation.
Complete editor/paste/undo/browse/preferred state and callbacks equal before/after rejection.
No retry against a newly built map.

setup: Capture mapping of registered marker.
actions: Reset; SetText the same literal marker without registering payload.
Deliver the old map.
assertions: Reject despite identical SourceText/caret.
No marker-interior move or stale payload resurrection.

setup: Capture geometry A and map.
actions: Resize A->B->A with same final dimensions.
Attempt admission of old map.
assertions: Apply the finalized identity rule; dimension equality alone is insufficient.
A rejected key leaves complete state/callbacks unchanged.

setup: Capture a map/provider owner.
actions: Dispose/recreate provider and controller with matching numeric revision/text/geometry.
Offer old map.
assertions: Reject foreign lifetime.
Do not retain prior callbacks/draft/paste/history owner references.

setup: Admit exactly one key against a valid captured layout.
actions: Change viewport after admission but before rendering.
assertions: Exactly one edit/preference transition.
Later frame uses current geometry; committed key is not replayed.

setup: Multiline draft with more rows than visible window.
actions: Change height while keeping width fixed.
PageUp then PageDown using finalized height policy.
assertions: Page extent comes from captured agreed height, not hardcoded three draft rows.
First/last editable membership uses the complete map.

setup: Capture source caret/navigation result and layout.
actions: Append transcript before view renders the new draft.
assertions: Draft-local row and final screen row origin remain distinct.
Rendering places the same source caret using current viewport transform.

setup: Draft has24 logical lines; cursor on first/middle/last in separate schedules.
actions: Use one-row viewport; perform Up/Down/page input.
assertions: Clipped single visible row does not classify every cursor as first/last editable row.
Cursor-follow visible origin is bounded and source caret remains legal.

setup: Drafts empty,LF,LF-LF.
actions: Render/navigation at columns1/2/5, heights1/3.
assertions: Assert agreed decoration/editable-row/empty-line representation and caret affinity.
No gaps/overlap in complete source mapping.

setup: Draft abcd with cursor0/4; prefix consumes drawing cells.
actions: Resize columns5->1->5; Up/Down at exact logical end.
assertions: Assert finalized exact-width end affinity in both rendered placement and navigation map.
Prompt-only/trailing rows do not silently change history eligibility.

setup: Register multiline large paste producing a long marker.
actions: Widths9->5->24; repeated Up/Down across marker continuation rows.
assertions: Cursor never ends inside a registered atomic marker.
Continuation/decorative rows agree with actual rendered cells.
Pre-snap UTF16 preference returns after resize as source fixture requires.

setup: Set literal marker text without paste registration.
actions: Move across same width/resize schedules as registered marker.
assertions: Literal marker does not inherit unrelated atomic registration.
No expansion against an old lifetime registry.

setup: Drafts CJK,emoji,ZWJ,combining and long-short-long source fixtures.
actions: Render narrow-wide-narrow; Up/Down then page movement.
assertions: Compare full source snapshots/callbacks and agreed rendered caret.
Use source UTF16 preferred/pre-snap offsets, not substituted cell arithmetic.
Legal scalar and agreed grapheme/marker boundaries.

setup: Hold actual fake-console frame write.
actions: Request mapping/navigation while view draw is held.
Cancel/dispose while operation is pending; release owned write.
assertions: Pure map computation performs no terminal I/O/callback/semaphore wait.
Deterministic admission/rejection; no sync wait cycle.
Read/timer/write cleanup joins; mapper never disposes borrowed lease.

setup: Complete draft/paste/undo/browse/preference state and callbacks captured.
actions: Mapping provider throws at admission.
assertions: Exception follows agreed transport policy.
No state mutation, callback, duplicate history insertion or retry.

setup: Hold display/navigation boundary and fill admitted queue.
actions: Offer one event/render beyond finalized cap; cancel/dispose then release.
assertions: Declared bounded rejection; no duplicate read loop or silent dropped authoritative event.
All owned work joins without killing unrelated processes.

setup: Have a valid active draft.
actions: Supply default/uninitialized or empty rows where the finalized map requires editable coverage.
assertions: Pre-effect rejection preserves all state/callbacks.

setup: Prepare each malformed case separately.
actions: Rows have source gaps,overlaps,wrong ordering,negative lengths or checked integer overflow.
assertions: Validate before effects/allocating from unchecked lengths.
Preserve complete state/callbacks.

setup: Registered marker plus emoji/combining source text.
actions: Offer row/caret boundaries splitting a scalar or violating finalized atomic/grapheme policy.
assertions: Pre-effect rejection preserves text,expansion,cursor,undo,browse/preferred offsets and notifications.

setup: Valid admitted recall/navigation operation.
actions: Throw from exactly one actual TextChanged observer after commit.
assertions: Retain documented committed state; propagate original failure.
No generic rollback,key replay or extra undo/history insertion.

setup: Valid operation and a controlled nonrecursive callback.
actions: Observer performs one permitted reentrant action under finalized policy.
assertions: Assert declared admission/rejection and exactly-once notifications/undo effects.
Never infer broad callback concurrency support from this single schedule.

setup: Expanded paste submission callback held.
actions: Cancel before callback returns; release callback.
assertions: Run joins held callback/read and does not replay submission.
Exactly one/zero history insertion according to finalized acceptance receipt, not continuation boolean.

setup: Host fixture records effect before returning false or throwing.
actions: Execute separate false/throw schedules.
assertions: Continuation/quit and original failure remain preserved.
Classify history only by finalized receipt/effect boundary.
No implicit rollback or key replay.

setup: Accepted-user-submission receipt or agreed equivalent emitted.
actions: Throw during reset/output render.
assertions: History insertion follows the chosen durable acceptance boundary exactly once.
Rendering failure does not retroactively undo accepted effect.

setup: Hold first expanded submit and queue another Enter.
actions: Complete physical EOF; release submission.
assertions: Preserve queued host invocation order/joins.
Recall insertion follows declared empty-command/repeated-Enter receipt rules, not blindly every callback.

setup: Browse recalled prompt with a saved draft/marker context.
actions: Switch/reset/recreate session/provider using finalized hydration/lifetime policy.
assertions: No old draft resurrection,stale registry expansion or retained session/provider/callback references.
Only immutable admitted recall strings/data survive where explicitly allowed.

setup: 100/101 history entries and exact declared budget boundary.
actions: Add/hydrate next/oversized entries in separate cases.
assertions: Specified oldest eviction or pre-effect rejection.
Count entry strings and all declared retained browse/paste/undo/map allocations.

setup: Maximum admitted history plus large browse draft,paste registry,expanded cache and undo.
actions: Enter/leave browsing,undo,reset and lifetime end.
assertions: Aggregate bound remains explicit; references release at declared boundaries.
No history-owned copy of source marker payload unless contract declares it.

setup: 65536-character draft at width1.
actions: Build/render full map repeatedly across1->256->1 widths.
assertions: Bound complete rows/cells/cache using actual representation.
No expanded-string allocation per row; no unbounded retained map versions.

setup: Admit maps/history/browse state and held provider operations.
actions: Dispose then construct new owner.
assertions: Joined provider work and released references.
No numeric revision collision admits the prior lifetime map.
